thread:
Acme AP: Hi Redwood — our AP team cannot process payment unless we receive a formal invoice that includes our PO number. Procurement has put a hold until PO# PO-98372 is referenced and vendor onboarding (W-9 / VAT) is complete. Can you reissue or provide a pro-forma?

Jamie (Support): Thanks — looping in @Priya and @Lina. Can you confirm if we can reissue the invoice with the PO reference? I can put the account on a brief billing hold while this gets sorted.

Priya (Account Exec): FYI Acme is on Dedicated capacity and we're usually flexible, but procurement is strict. @Lina any blockers from finance side to reissue with PO?

Lina (Finance): We can reissue or generate a pro-forma. Requirements from our side: legal entity name, tax ID (W-9 for US or VAT ID for EU), billing address that matches the PO, and the AP contact email (ap@acme.com). If VAT applies (they provided GB number) we need the VAT ID to apply the correct reverse-charge text. Which would they prefer: pro-forma to trigger PO or a formal invoice to be paid after PO is issued?

Acme AP: Pro-forma works best — procurement will raise the PO against the pro-forma and return the PO number to you. AP email is ap@acme.com. Also note the corporate card on file declined last week; procurement wants assurance there will be no service interruption during the PO flow.

Jamie (Support): :thumbsup: No service interruption right now. I set a soft billing hold flag so automated invoice attempts are paused. Action items I will take: 1) set billing hold, 2) attach this thread to billing ticket INC-7890, 3) forward any PO/pdf to finance when received. Link to ticket: https://redwood.support/billing/INC-7890

Lina (Finance): Good. Once they upload the vendor docs + PO we will create pro-forma PF-2026-331 referencing PO-98372. Note on VAT: if they supply VAT ID (format like GB123456789) we must include reverse-charge wording — please ask procurement to include VAT ID on the PO. Also ask if they require e-invoicing (Ariba/Peppol) — we can export XML if needed.

Priya (Account Exec): Confirmed amounts align with the existing contract. @Acme AP — please upload the PO PDF or paste the PO number here and we'll proceed. If procurement needs a copy of the SOW/quote I'll attach it to the pro-forma.

billing-bot: AUTO: Billing ticket INC-7890 updated by Jamie — status: waiting_for_customer_documents.

Acme AP: Uploading PO now: https://acme.example.com/po/PO-98372.pdf — legal name: Acme Corporation, VAT: GB123456789 (EU VAT), AP contact: ap@acme.com. Thanks.

Jamie (Support): Received the PO link, forwarding to finance. Lina — sent on slack and added to INC-7890. ETA for pro-forma: ~4 hours.

Lina (Finance): Pro-forma PF-2026-331 created and emailed to ap@acme.com with PO reference PO-98372. Final invoice will be reissued after procurement confirms acceptance. Marking INC-7890 as pending_customer_confirmation. :white_check_mark:
